cards.title: Bonds: quick review
cards.body: Bonds to $10$: $1 + 9$, $2 + 8$, $3 + 7$, $4 + 6$, $5 + 5$. Bonds to $20$ add a ten: $13 + 7 = 20$. Bonds to $100$: the tens make $9$ and the ones make $10$, so $37 + 63 = 100$.

cards.title: Make 10 first: quick review
cards.body: Crossing a ten? Fill up to the ten, then add the rest: $8 + 5 = 8 + 2 + 3 = 13$. Taking away across a ten? Go back to the ten, then take the rest: $13 - 5 = 13 - 3 - 2 = 8$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you'll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.

prompts: Where could you use a bond to $100$ outside school?
